Can koine contribute a diverse opinion for this model? (pre-flight)

Source: R/integration.R
koine_can_contribute.Rd

A cheap capability predicate — it resolves the battery but fits nothing — for a parent panel's backend-availability gate. Returns TRUE when at least two independent opinion lenses would enrol, or a single reason string from the abstention taxonomy otherwise ("feature_unsupported", "no_diverse_battery", or "pass_invalid" for a malformed model). Because the PSIS reliability gate and weight-degeneracy check can only be evaluated after fitting, a TRUE here is necessarily optimistic: koine may still abstain at synthesise() time. The predicate is a floor, not a guarantee.

Usage

koine_can_contribute(
  formula,
  data,
  family,
  resources = list(allowed_tiers = 1L),
  registry = koine_stage1_registry()
)

Arguments

formula, data, family

As for koine_pass().

resources

A resources list (see koine_pass()); defaults to tier 1.

registry

A registry list; defaults to koine_stage1_registry().

Value

TRUE, or a single reason-code string.

See also

koine_opinion_draws(), synthesise()

Examples

d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(40), x = rnorm(40))
koine_can_contribute(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
#> [1] TRUE
